parameters.content:
## CARD 1: 🏆 FINAL COMPLIANCE AGENT
Deterministic compliance adjudication layer.
Evaluates aggregated child agent outcomes against mandatory procurement compliance policy.

## CARD 2: ⚙️ DETERMINISTIC DECISION RULES
Strict rule hierarchy:
1. Input malformation / invalid state -> ERROR
2. Mandatory domain failure -> NOT_QUALIFIED
3. Mandatory error or unexecuted -> REVIEW_REQUIRED / NOT_QUALIFIED
4. Risk score >= 50 -> REVIEW_REQUIRED / NOT_QUALIFIED
5. Low confidence (<0.70) -> REVIEW_REQUIRED
6. All mandatory passed -> QUALIFIED
